item.title: Comprehensive Website UX Design Review
item.description:

I’m especially interested in practical, clearly explained fixes I can pass straight to my developer or tackle myself.
Deliverables • A concise report (PDF or Google Doc) outlining each issue you spot, why it matters, and a specific, actionable recommendation to resolve it. • Annotated screenshots or short Loom clips for complex points. • A prioritised checklist so I know which changes will have the biggest impact on user experience first.
I’ll share the URL as soon as we start. If you have a proven eye for modern UI/UX best practices and can translate observations into clear next steps, I’d love your insight.

item.description:
750-1500 AUD | I’m ready to launch a clean, modern website that showcases my local services business and performs well in search. The site will include four core pages—Home, Services, Portfolio and Contact—built with responsive design so customers on mobile and desktop have the same smooth experience.
Strong on-page SEO is essential: intuitive URL structure, proper heading hierarchy, meta titles and descriptions written around our service keywords, plus fast-loading, accessible code. I’d also like basic analytics integration so I can track traffic and enquiries from day one.
Please handle complete design and development, supply any royalty-free imagery needed, and make sure the finished site is easy for me to update. When we wrap up, I expect the live site, all source files and a brief hand-over guide that shows me how to add future portfolio items and adjust content.

item.title: Framer Site Content & SEO Refresh
item.description:
12-18 EUR/hr | I built my website in Framer and now need a quick, tidy refresh focused on content accuracy and basic search visibility.
Here’s what I would like done: • Replace or adjust text, images, and any other content that no longer matches my current messaging. • Give the landing page a once-over, then make sure it is properly tied into the sitemap so search engines can index it. • Carry out a light SEO review across the whole site—page titles, meta descriptions, open-graph tags, alt text, robots.txt, XML sitemap submission—nothing advanced, just the essentials to ensure every page is crawlable and has the right on-page signals.
I will provide the updated copy, imagery, and Framer project access. You handle the edits inside Framer, regenerate the sitemap, confirm indexing through Search Console (or similar), and send a brief report of the SEO tweaks you made so I can track future changes.
If you know Framer inside out and are comfortable with foundational SEO, this should be a straightforward job.

item.title: Form, Address Check & Booking
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’ve already generated the core pages of my website with ChatGPT, but the interactive pieces are still missing. Here’s what I now need built and seamlessly wired into the existing code:
1. A single-page form that captures the customer’s name, email, phone, validated street address, an optional note, and one uploaded photo (jpg / png, max 10 MB). 2. Real-time address verification that confirms the street, city, state, and ZIP are genuine before the form can be submitted. 3. A simple appointment picker that shows my predefined available time slots so the customer can lock in a date and time immediately. 4. Google reCAPTCHA (or a comparable spam-blocking tool) on the form. 5. A summary email sent to my chosen mailbox every time the form is completed, containing all entered details, the image as an attachment or download link, and the selected appointment slot.
You may work in plain JavaScript/PHP or a lightweight framework—whatever slots pain-free into the HTML that’s already there. I’ll provide the current files and hosting credentials at kickoff.
Acceptance criteria • Address field blocks obvious fakes and incomplete inputs. • File upload rejects unsupported types and oversize images. • Time slots cannot be double-booked; once reserved, they disappear from the picker. • Successful submission clears the form, displays a confirmation message, and triggers the email within one minute.
Feel free to let me know any libraries or APIs you propose so I can approve them before you start.

item.title: Low-Ticket Training Funnel Setup
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m rolling out a low-cost Business & Sales mini-training that will act as the front door to my education ecosystem. I already host the members’ area on Skool (or any similar tool you’re comfortable with), and I need a complete funnel that brings prospects in smoothly and moves them toward my higher-ticket programs.
Scope of work – Build or integrate a clean checkout page for the entry-level offer (think Stripe, ThriveCart, Kajabi Payments—whatever fits best with Skool). – Connect an automated email follow-up sequence that nurtures new buyers, delivers login instructions, and progressively introduces the next-level training. – Structure at least one in-funnel upgrade/upsell that can be presented right after purchase and again inside the email flow. – Tag and segment contacts so I always know who bought the basic course and who moved up. – Set up tracking so I can measure conversion rates at every step.
Traffic sources I’ll be driving visitors from paid social ads plus my own website and organic posts. Please make sure any pixels, UTM parameters, or other tracking hooks are in place so ad performance is crystal clear.
Deliverables 1. Fully functional funnel pages (checkout, thank-you/upsell, post-purchase onboarding). 2. Email sequence copy and automations ready to go live. 3. Integration with Skool (or equivalent) for instant course access. 4. Documentation or short Loom walkthrough showing how everything connects.
Acceptance criteria • Test purchase flows from ad click to course access without errors. • Emails send with correct timing and personalization. • Upsell offer displays for 100 % of buyers and routes payments correctly. • Conversions and revenue visible in the dashboard we agree on.
If you’ve built similar low-ticket funnels and know your way around Skool, click-funnels-style builders, and email tools like ActiveCampaign or ConvertKit, I’d love to see your approach and timeline.

item.title: TAAG 1 - 100% copy of a web site preserving the highest quality - text and images
item.description:
30-250 USD | I will send you a single website link and need an exact, high-quality offline replica of everything you can reach from that URL—roughly 30 pages and about 100 images. Every public page, downloadable asset, and any contact or enquiry forms must work locally just as they do online.
The finished mirror should keep the original directory structure, internal links, fonts, stylesheets, JavaScript, and meta data so that I can open index.html on my desktop and navigate the whole site without an internet connection.
Please deliver:

I will consider the job done when the archive loads flawlessly on my side, all pages render identically to the live site, and every resource is accounted for. If that passes, we can discuss any follow-up edits or redesigns.

item.title: WordPress Developer Needed – On-Demand Website Building (Long-Term Opportunity)
item.description:
30-250 CAD | Project Description: We are looking for reliable WordPress developers to join our team on an on-demand basis.
IMPORTANT: This is NOT a full-time or part-time job.
There are no fixed working hours and no guaranteed number of projects. You are expected to have other clients and accept other freelance jobs.
However, when we contact you with a website assignment, you must respond promptly and tell us immediately whether you are available.
If you accept the assignment, you must complete the website within a couple of hours.
HOW THE WORK WORKS 1. We provide you with a ready-to-use WordPress starter website. 2. The starter website is built from our master blueprint and includes the necessary templates, designs, layouts, and add-ons. 3. Your job is to customize the website for the assigned business. 4. You will use AI tools to generate appropriate website content and find suitable images. 5. You will populate the existing templates with the content and images. 6. You will check that everything looks professional and works correctly. 7. You will submit the completed website for our review and make any necessary corrections.
You are NOT expected to design websites from scratch, develop plugins, or write complex code. Most of the work is already prepared for you.
PAID TRAINING — $100 Before receiving regular assignments, you must complete our training program. - Total training payment: $100. - Training includes building five websites. - Each website uses different add-ons and configurations. - The purpose is to familiarize you with our master blueprint, templates, tools, and working procedures.
AVAILABILITY REQUIREMENTS 1. This is strictly on-demand freelance work. 2. You are free and encouraged to work with other clients. 3. When contacted, you must respond promptly. 4. You must immediately confirm whether you can accept the assignment. 5. If you are unavailable, simply tell us. There is no penalty for declining an assignment. 6. Once you accept an assignment, you are expected to complete it within a couple of hours. 7. Reliability, communication, and meeting agreed deadlines are essential.
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - Experienced with WordPress and Elementor. - Comfortable working with existing templates and add-ons. - Familiar with AI tools for generating website content and sourcing images. - Able to work quickly without sacrificing quality. - Reliable, responsive, and detail-oriented. - Interested in a long-term freelance relationship.
IMPORTANT > We are not looking for someone to build complicated websites from scratch. > We have already developed the system, master blueprint, templates, and designs. > We need someone who can take our prepared starter website, add suitable AI-generated content and images, customize it for the assigned business, and deliver a professional, completed website quickly.
If you are an experienced WordPress developer looking for occasional freelance assignments that can fit around your other work, we would like to hear from you.

An account area is essential so buyers can register, view order history, and track shipments in real time. I’m ready to move quickly once we agree on the platform and timeline, and will provide branding assets and product data in the format you request. Show me relevant e-commerce sites you have built and outline your development approach so we can get started.

item.title: Senior Web Developer - Public Website Maintenance, Security and UX (Award-Contingent, Part-Time Retainer)
item.description:
20-40 USD/hr | Senior Web Developer - Public Website Maintenance, Security and UX (Award-Contingent, Part-Time Retainer).
About the client: Samson Global Solutions LLC (SGS), a Virginia small business (SDVOSB, SWaM-certified) based in Culpeper County, VA.
This is an award-contingent teaming position. SGS is preparing a proposal for a public-sector public relations and marketing contract on the Eastern Shore of Virginia. If SGS is awarded the contract, the selected professional will work part-time on a monthly retainer basis for a 3-year term with up to two 1-year renewals. No work or pay is guaranteed unless and until the contract is awarded and a separate written agreement is signed.
By applying, you agree that SGS may name you, with your permission, as proposed key personnel and include your resume and the work samples you designate in the proposal.
End client: a public broadband authority on the Eastern Shore of Virginia. Remote work is fine. Occasional on-site meetings on the Eastern Shore (Accomack/Northampton counties, VA) are a plus.
SCOPE (IF AWARDED) - Routine maintenance, CMS patching, security monitoring and daily backups of a public-authority website - UI/UX improvements to the residential service-availability lookup and sign-up pages - Rapid publishing of board notices, news and service advisories
REQUIRED - 5+ years maintaining and securing production CMS websites (for example WordPress or a similar CMS): updates, plugins, hardening, backups and restores, uptime monitoring - UI/UX work on forms, lookup tools or sign-up flows; accessibility (WCAG) awareness - Live site links you built or maintain
PREFERRED - Public-sector, utility or ISP websites - Analytics and conversion tracking
HOW TO APPLY - send everything in your first bid/proposal on this project (do not send materials by email): - Resume or CV (attach to your bid) - Live-site / work-sample links (required) - 3 client references from the last 3 years (entity, service provided, contact person, phone or email). The proposal requires them. - Answers to these screening questions: a) List 2-3 live sites you maintain or built, and your role on each. b) Describe your patching, backup and security monitoring routine. - Availability (hours per month over a 3-year term) - Proposed hourly rate
The hourly range shown is a posting placeholder only, not a rate commitment or offer; the final rate is agreed later.
Application deadline: November 28, 2026. SGS will make its selection by November 30, 2026.

item.title: Modern Electrical Branding & Site

In short, anything printable that busy parents, small-business owners, event planners, or other motivated buyers will see and purchase without hesitation.
Here’s the flow I have in mind:
• Product creation – Original, on-trend designs delivered as print-ready PDFs (300 dpi) and editable files where it makes sense. – Smart use of Canva, Adobe Illustrator/Photoshop, or similar tools so the artwork is both high quality and easy for me to tweak later.
• Shop setup & optimisation – Branded storefront (logo, banner, about section, policies) that feels cohesive and trustworthy. – SEO-rich titles, tags, and descriptions built from keyword research with Marmalead/eRank or your preferred tool. – Attractive mock-ups for every listing to boost click-through rates.
• Launch plan – A simple marketing checklist covering first-week promos, Pinterest pin ideas, and email capture tactics so I’m not left guessing after go-live.
Deliverables are complete once the shop is live, listings are published, and I can download every digital file exactly as a buyer would. If this aligns with your skill set, let’s map out the milestones and get the shop earning.

item.title: Local Election Campaign Site Design
item.description:
250-750 GBP | Website Developer Required – Political Campaign Website with 30 Individual Pages
We are seeking quotations from experienced website developers to design and build a professional, attractive and easy-to-manage website for a political campaign.
Applicants must have demonstrable experience of developing similar multi-page websites and provide examples of previous work. Applications without relevant portfolio evidence will not be considered.
1. Website Structure
We require one main website comprising:
One central homepage providing general campaign information, news, announcements, policy priorities and updates.
Up to 30 individual pages, all using an identical design template but containing different content for individual local campaigns.
The local pages must be accessible both through the main website's navigation menu and directly through unique URLs or QR codes printed on campaign materials.
2. Individual Campaign Pages
Each of the 30 pages should include:
Candidate information, photographs and introductions.
Local issues, priorities and campaign commitments.
Local campaigns and community activities.
A news and updates section.
An email or contact form enabling visitors to communicate directly with the relevant candidate or campaign team.
3. Technical Requirements
A single, easy-to-use content management system (CMS), such as WordPress or an equivalent.
A shared template for all 30 local pages.
Central administration, with the option for authorised users to update their individual pages.
Fully responsive design for mobile phones, tablets and desktop computers.
Simple news publishing and content updating.
Contact forms with appropriate data protection arrangements.
Basic website analytics.
QR-code-compatible individual page addresses.
Appropriate security, backups and straightforward ongoing maintenance.
4. Branding and Design
The website must follow established political party branding and house-style requirements.
Approved logos, colours and relevant branding guidance will be supplied.
We are looking for a clean, modern and professional appearance, with a consistent design across the entire website.
5. Quotations and Experience
We invite freelancers to submit a proposal including:
Examples of comparable websites they have developed, preferably involving political campaigns, membership organisations or multi-page community websites.
Their proposed platform and technical approach.
An indication of the total cost for the homepage and up to 30 template-based local pages.
Estimated development timescale.
Details of what is included in the quotation, including setup, testing, training and launch.
Any ongoing hosting, licensing or maintenance costs.
Confirmation that the finished website can be independently managed and updated by our team.
6. Selection Requirements
We will only consider freelancers who can demonstrate relevant experience and provide working examples of previous projects.
Please include links to at least two comparable websites, together with a brief explanation of your role in their development.
We are seeking a reliable and cost-effective solution, not an unnecessarily complex or expensive bespoke development.
Our priority is a well-designed, functional website that can be easily managed by non-technical users, with one central homepage and up to 30 consistent, individually editable campaign pages.
We look forward to receiving quotations from suitably experienced developers.

item.title: Full-Stack Medical Consult Development
item.description:
35-55 USD/hr | I am building a secure, end-to-end web platform that lets patients handle every stage of a medical visit online. On the patient side they must be able to search a doctor’s availability, book a slot, pay for the appointment at checkout, join an in-browser video call at the scheduled time, and keep an ongoing chat thread where they can upload lab results or images before and after the consultation.

• Doctors will open a calendar view to confirm or adjust availability, enter consultation notes, launch the video room with one click, and review files patients have shared. • Clinic staff will oversee bookings and patient records, while a super-admin tier manages users, doctors, and global site settings.
A modern, responsive front-end (React, Vue or similar) tied to a robust back-end (Node/Express, Laravel, Django — I am flexible) will be required. I will provide wireframes and user-flow diagrams; you handle the coding, database design, and initial deployment to a cloud host of your choice. Clean, well-commented code and a short walkthrough video will be the acceptance criteria.

item.title: UX/UI Designer Needed for a Modern Digital Marketplace Platform
item.description:
25-50 USD/hr | Project Type: Freelance / Contract Experience Level: Intermediate to Expert Engagement: Project-Based (Potential for Long-Term Collaboration)
Project Overview
We are looking for a talented and experienced UX/UI Designer to help us design a modern, intuitive, and visually appealing marketplace platform.
Our goal is to build a user-friendly digital marketplace that provides a seamless experience for buyers and sellers.
